source: Records mode: Calculate interest (line 45) reads input.accounts, categoryBalances, disclosureGroups, cardLinks as arrays of records with contract field names (acct_id, group_id, curr_bal, curr_cyc_credit, curr_cyc_debit; acct_id/type_cd/cat_cd/bal; group_id/type_cd/cat_cd/interest_rate; acct_id/card_num), so the only renaming is the list cardXrefs -> cardLinks. businessDate and interestRunDate default to 2022-07-18 and 2022071800 when absent (records mode supplies no parameters, as in every records-mode run).
